crossRefs.note: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’ ”
Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth…
for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore…
or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been…
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will…
even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in…
who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

translations.web: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
translations.bsb: Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
translations.kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
translations.asv: For we who have believed do enter into that rest; even as he hath said, As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
